mapper.select: SELECT S.L_STORAGEID AS storageid, S.C_CATALOG AS catalog, S.C_SUBKEYID AS subkeyid, S.C_FILENAME AS filename, S.L_FILESIZE AS filesize, S.C_CREATOR AS createId, S.D_CREATEDATE AS createTime, S.C_SECURITYLEVEL AS securitylevel FROM TBLOBSTORAGE S, TACCOINFO A WHERE S.C_SUBKEYID = A.C_CUSTNO AND A.C_FUNDACCO = #{sp.fundacct}

SELECT S.L_STORAGEID AS storageid, S.C_CATALOG AS catalog, S.C_SUBKEYID AS subkeyid, S.B_ACCESSORY AS filecontent, S.C_FILENAME AS filename, S.L_FILESIZE AS filesize, S.C_CREATOR AS createId, S.D_CREATEDATE AS createTime, S.C_SECURITYLEVEL AS securitylevel FROM TBLOBSTORAGE S, TACCOINFO A WHERE S.C_SUBKEYID = A.C_CUSTNO AND S.L_STORAGEID = #{sp.storageid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBLOBSTORAGE ( L_STORAGEID, C_CATALOG, C_SUBKEYID, C_FILENAME, B_ACCESSORY, L_FILESIZE, C_CREATOR, D_CREATEDATE, C_SECURITYLEVEL ) VALUES ( SEQ_TBLOBSTORAGE.NEXTVAL, #{catalog}, #{subkeyid}, #{filename}, #{filecontent}, #{filesize}, #{createId}, SYSDATE, #{securitylevel} )
